axioms.name: Experimental.P06_01.harmonic_residual_p_integral
axioms.meaning: All non-p-multiple terms of the actual finite harmonic sum have p-integral residual.

axioms.name: Experimental.P06_01.fiber_integrand_integrable
axioms.meaning: Integrability of the actual transformed polynomial kernel, before proving Jacobian substitution.

literal_statement_repair_policy: No repair is silently substituted for the verbatim target.
coverage: Encodes the actual unit-square moments, proposed fiber map, transformed integrand and finite harmonic residual. Existing monomial moment identities are imported, not axiomatized.
remaining: Prove the fiber change-of-variables/Jacobian theorem and Mellin divided-difference formula; discharge harmonic residual integrality; derive exact crossing-index valuation and invertibility of the displayed local leading block. No determinant valuation is a prerequisite axiom.
